resources.string: Private downloads stay managed by Play. Choose a normal folder to save audio files that appear in your file manager. Private files are removed when Play is uninstalled; files in a chosen folder remain.
New downloads are saved here after finishing and need temporary phone space. Existing songs stay where they are until you move them.
Move completed downloads to %1$s? Originals are removed only after each new copy is saved successfully.
Some file operations could not finish. Your songs have been kept. Check storage access and available space, then try Move existing downloads again.
Could not use this location. Choose a writable folder or check that your SD card is available.
Some saved files could not be deleted. Check that their storage is available and that Play still has access.
No writable SD card detected. Insert a card to use private SD-card storage, or choose a normal folder.
This also deletes audio files saved by Play in your chosen folder. Other files are left alone.
A saved song is unavailable. Reconnect its storage or restore folder access. Play will try streaming when an internet connection is available.
